title: /health DB probe silently fails under SQLAlchemy 2.0 — connectivity never actually verified
evidence: main.py:30 `db.execute("SELECT 1")` passes a raw string; SQLAlchemy 2.0 (requirements.txt: sqlalchemy==2.0.31) raises ArgumentError for un-texted SQL, so the except branch on main.py:32-35 is always taken and /health returns {"database": "test-mode"} even in production. The health check can never detect a real DB outage.
suggestion: Wrap the probe in sqlalchemy.text(): `db.execute(text("SELECT 1"))`, and let a genuine failure surface as unhealthy (503) rather than being masked as 'test-mode'.

title: Deprecated @app.on_event("startup") lifecycle hook
evidence: main.py:18 uses `@app.on_event("startup")`, deprecated in current FastAPI in favor of the lifespan context manager.
suggestion: Migrate to the `lifespan=` handler on FastAPI() to avoid deprecation warnings.

title: Pydantic v2 deprecated .dict() call
evidence: main.py:82 `book.dict(exclude_unset=True)`; Pydantic 2.10.3 (requirements.txt) deprecates .dict() in favor of .model_dump().

title: Validation returns 422 rather than 400 for missing title/author
evidence: schemas.py:9-10 Field(..., min_length=1) yields FastAPI's default 422 Unprocessable Entity; test_api.py:82,92 assert 422. TASK.md phrases validation errors as 400. 422 is FastAPI-idiomatic and satisfies R9, noted only for cross-run comparison.
suggestion: No change required; 422 is standard for FastAPI request-body validation.
